message.content:
**All‑time Premier League Assist Leader**

| Player | Club(s) | Total Assists* |
|--------|---------|----------------|
| **Ryan Giggs** | Manchester United | **162** |

\*Assists counted only while playing in the English Premier League (1992–present), based on the *official Premier League statistics database*.  
(Other sources sometimes report slightly different totals because of how “assisted goal” was recorded before 2009.)

---

### Why Ryan Giggs?

* He played 17 seasons in the Premier League (1992‑2015).
* His creative role at left wing / midfield produced an unprecedented number of set‑piece passes into the box.
* No other player has surpassed his tally since he retired – even prolific playmakers such as Frank Lampard (147) and Steven Gerrard (140) trail behind him.

> **Note:** If you’re looking for the *current season’s* assist champion, it changes each year. For example:
>
> * 2022/23 – Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City): 20 assists  
> * 2021/22 – Bruno Fernandes (Tottenham Hotspur): 16 assists  

If you need the most recent season’s numbers or wish to filter by club/team, let me know!
